title_original: 중국산 합판에 대한 덤핑방지관세 부과에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM <No. 1073, July 2, 2024>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.
Article 2 (Period of Validity) These Rules shall remain effective for five years from the date of their promulgation.
Article 3 (Applicability to Goods Subject to Anti-Dumping Measures during the Review Period) These Rules shall apply beginning with goods for which an import declaration is filed on or after November 6, 2023.
